title: Obsidian+
description: This Project Add Obsidian Tools And Armor Which Are Really Overpowered
body:
Obsidian Gear

Obsidian Gear adds a brand new equipment set to Minecraft: Obsidian Armor and Tools. Built from one of the toughest materials in the game, this gear is designed for players who want stronger, more durable equipment for exploring, mining, farming, and fighting.

This mod introduces a full obsidian set including a helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe. Obsidian tools are powerful and long-lasting, making them perfect for players who spend a lot of time mining or battling mobs. The armor also provides strong protection, helping you survive tougher situations in your world.
🏗️ How to Obtain Obsidian Materials

The mod uses a simple crafting progression to turn raw obsidian into usable gear:

    To get Obsidian Ore: Place 1 Obsidian Block a crafting table to receive 18 Obsidian Ore.

    To craft an Obsidian Ingot: Place 9 Obsidian Ore in a crafting table, filling all slots (3×3).

    To craft an Obsidian Block: Place 9 Obsidian Ingots in a crafting table, filling all slots (3×3).

Once you have your Obsidian Ingots, you can craft the full armor and tool set (including the hoe) using the standard Minecraft crafting patterns.
✨ Features

    Obsidian Ore Block: A new intermediate resource for crafting.

    Full Obsidian Armor set: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots.

    Full Obsidian Tool set: Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.

    Custom material progression: A unique crafting loop from block to ore to ingot.

    Strong durability and protection: Built for high-intensity survival.

    Vanilla-friendly gameplay: Fits naturally into the Minecraft world.

    Lightweight and simple to use: No complex machinery or smelting required.
